title: Evidence record
description: Common evidence record linking a claim to its source and access classification.

claim.description: The single factual claim this record supports.

source_uri.description: Public or internal URI for the source, when one exists.

source_record_id.description: Opaque source record identifier when the source is not addressable by URI.

published_at.description: Publication time when available; sourced only from the source record's published_at field.

occurred_at.description: Event or activity occurrence time when available; sourced only from the source record's occurred_at field. Distinct from published_at.

excerpt.description: Verbatim or normalized source passage supporting the claim.

question_ids.description: Optional: research question IDs the source record was associated with. Carried for provenance only; carrying a question ID does not prove the question has been answered.
